designs.why: Strong, legible mountain silhouette with a clear light/dark split and a good vignette; stars frame the summit well and the headlamps read as a rising diagonal. Placement on the model is good (upper back, centred). Weaknesses: the print area has a large empty lower third, so the artwork sits high and the block feels slightly top-heavy; the right-flank lines ending in ragged horizontal streaks look a bit like a glitch/scan artefact rather than a deliberate engraver's fade; the dark north face is dense with broken dashes that go muddy from a distance.
designs.fix: Tighten and soften the right-flank line ends (stagger them more gradually along a smooth vignette curve instead of long ragged streaks) so the vignette reads as intentional engraving rather than a rendering artefact.
